subject: codemachine-cli
title: Every engine adapter hard-codes the flags that disable its engine's own protections: bypassPermissions, danger-full-access, auto-approve
one_why: Nuance vs ouroboros-11/plandex approval-only-enforcement: not merely a missing boundary -- codemachine actively strips the kernel/CLI sandboxes it inherits from seven engines with no config path to re-enable them, so a prompt injection in any orchestrated session runs full-access across all of them; workflow 'approvals' gate progression, never tool execution.

subject: codemachine-cli
title: 55,434 LOC, zero test files, CI runs nothing but tag-gated binary builds
evidence: find over whole tree: no __tests__/test/tests dirs, no *test*/*spec* files in src; .github/workflows/build.yml:3-7 (workflow_dispatch + tag v* only); package.json test script is an empty bun test ceremony; husky in devDeps with no .husky/ dir
one_why: Nuance vs free-code-4: this is a real 2.5k-star product, not a leaked snapshot, but census test_loc 0 is confirmed accurate and no push-time check of any kind (lint/typecheck/test) exists -- every crash-recovery and FSM guarantee in the codebase is unexercised; the recovery story caps orchestration at 7 because nothing can show it works.

subject: codemachine-cli
title: Seven-rival-CLI adapter matrix as the whole product, but without aeon's capability manifest or contract tests
one_why: Second convergence with aeon-1 on rival CLIs as interchangeable headless backends; codemachine proves the shape generalizes but shows the failure mode of the contract's absence: per-adapter model maps and telemetry parsers duplicated by hand with zero tests against any of the seven envelopes.

subject: codemachine-cli
title: Inter-agent step handoff over MCP: propose_step_completion (artifact path + sha256 + success-criteria checklist) -> schema validation -> approve_step_transition by a second agent
evidence: src/infra/mcp/servers/workflow-signals/tools.ts:11-53 (propose tool with pattern-locked step_id/artifact_hash and boolean checklist minProperties); src/workflows/signals/mcp/controller.ts:1-37 (wait-propose -> validate -> wait-approve, approved|rejected|revision_needed)
one_why: No other subject makes the two-agent propose/validate/approve transition the core workflow primitive; distinct from ouroboros validated-finish-gate (host-forced reviewer at the end) -- here the gate is between every step and its acceptance evidence (hash + checklist) is machine-validated before the reviewer agent is even consulted.

subject: codemachine-cli
title: Agents steer the workflow control loop by writing .codemachine/memory/directive.json {action: loop|checkpoint|stop|continue}, read by per-behavior evaluators
evidence: src/workflows/directives/reader.ts:13 (file path) ; loop/evaluator.ts:22-46 (loop action -> step-back with maxIterations ceiling); checkpoint/evaluator.ts:17-31 (checkpoint -> workflow stop)
one_why: A zero-protocol control channel: any orchestrated agent can request iteration/checkpoint without MCP support, and the maxIterations bound prevents infinite loops; fragile in the other direction -- one shared global file with no writer identity, races unmitigated, and nothing tests the read/reset cycle.
